title: EXODROP: Orbital Exo-Suit
shortDescription: Jet-pack exo-suit action: fly, fight alien swarms and topple the Goliath.
fullDescription:
Drop from orbit in a powered exo-suit and take back three alien-held worlds.

EXODROP is a third-person sci-fi action game built on its own 3D engine. Leap on jump-jets, punch the afterburner to fly across canyons, and fight bio-mechanical swarms with your two AI wingmen at your side.

FOUR WEAPONS
VX-9 Pulse Carbine for rapid fire, Helios Rail-Lance for piercing critical hits, Valkyrie Swarm Pod to lock up to four targets with homing missiles, and Nova Arc-Mortar for a massive shockwave.

FLY, DON'T JUST WALK
Vertical jump-jets, supersonic afterburner flight, precision hover-zoom and an aerial seismic dive-slam. Each world has its own gravity.

THREE PLANETARY SECTORS
Ares Crimson Mesa, the low-gravity Europa Glacial Rift and the molten Io Obsidian Caldera. Destroy the three Spore Spires, then bring down the towering Dreadnought Goliath.

YOUR SQUAD
Wingmen ECHO-2 and ECHO-3 fly with you, call out targets and follow your orders: formation, weapons free or hold sector.

BUILT FOR PHONES
Twin-stick touch controls, and a 3D resolution that adapts to your phone so the action stays smooth. No ads, no account, works offline.
